operator_penalty.decision: PR #280 controller ruling 2026-10-11T19:40:47Z (before any replay metric)
operator_penalty.applies_to: operator-within-source columns only, in both hurdle parts; intercept unpenalized; depth, class and source keep RIDGE

detection.convention: Convention fixed in code before any replay metric existed (Macha, pending controller ratification). At each lambda the per-gene operator increment is loss(depth_class_source) - loss(operator) for detection (held-out log loss) and lpd(operator) - lpd(depth_class_source) for positive magnitude (held-out lognormal LPD), so positive means operator helps. 'Materially present' at a lambda: no failed fit at that lambda, median per-gene increment > 0, and the 95% gene-bootstrap interval of that median (2000 resamples, fixed seed) excludes 0. Genes share cells and donors, so the gene bootstrap is optimistic. SUPPORTED: materially present at all three lambdas. NOT_SUPPORTED: materially present at none. Otherwise PRIOR_SENSITIVE__UNRESOLVED.
